description: Permissions for the OCADE Control + Work window. The window loads the packaged application server over loopback, so the origin must be named here — Tauri v2 grants a remote page no IPC at all unless it is. Scoped to 127.0.0.1 and localhost ONLY: the application server binds to loopback and nothing else may ever address these commands. This grants the ABILITY TO ASK; it grants no authority. Every computer action still carries a MAC-signed envelope with a monotonic counter and a single-use nonce, is re-validated host-side against the safety core, and is refused outright for protected input. Filesystem, shell, HTTP and process permissions are deliberately absent here as they are for the overlay.
